question: A typical freestyle wrestling bout, is divided into ______ periods of three minutes each with a 30-second break in between.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A typical freestyle wrestling bout is divided into **2 periods** of three minutes each.
 
• There is a **30-second break** between the two periods.
 
• The aim of the bout is to pin the opponent or score points
